assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ROW 3 Phantom violet lavender silver palette: (1) glowing reserve battery storing electricity (passive), (2) stealth aircraft dashing away leaving translucent decoy, (3) focused violet laser piercing targets, (4) electronic interference wave disrupting enemy aircraft, (5) elegant escort drone with violet energy cannon. ROW 4 Astra warm orange ivory gold palette: (1) radiant stellar rune marking enemy (passive), (2) curved orbital barrier reflecting incoming bullets, (3) long stellar lance piercing the sky, (4) twin mirrored star projectiles converging, (5) rain of bright meteorites. ROW 5 Cinder fiery orange red pale yellow palette: (1) heated incendiary round with six embers (passive), (2) aircraft protected by flame shield, (3) four fuel canisters spreading burning pools, (4) expanding heat wave ring with flames, (5) concentrated inferno beam erupting from aircraft nose. Every cell a substantive low-poly illustration, not flat symbols or simple geometry. Uniform perfectly aligned 5x5 tile grid filling entire image.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game VFX sprite atlas, single square RGBA image with actual transparent background. Exactly 4 columns x 2 rows equal cells, no gutters, no borders, no text, no checkerboard. Every effect centered inside its cell with generous transparent 15% padding, no aircraft depicted. Top row: four animation frames of a beautiful spectral guardian protective aura, ethereal pale cyan pearl-white spirit wings embracing an empty transparent center for a player aircraft. Finely rendered translucent feather-like energy plumes, layered flowing wisps, spiritual protective shell, subtle golden highlights, not simple circles/polygons/shields. Frame sequence wings unfurling gently and gathering light, consistent silhouette and center. Bottom row: four animation frames of orange-red inferno energy charging at an aircraft nose: tiny concentrated ember gathering inward tongues of flame, then swirling energy increasing, then white-hot dense flame core, then fully charged bright core with inward sparks. Confined roughly circular compact fire energy, no long beam. Polished low-poly game art with softly glowing edges and detailed faceted energy, ready for additive blending over dark space. Strict uniform 4x2 grid.
